name: DOST
description: Dost is AI-native AP/AR automation. The Dost MCP server lets your AI assistant interact directly with your finance operations using natural language. Retrieve invoices and their details, configure data enrichment, build approval workflows, and assign them to financial documents, all through simple requests instead of navigating multiple screens.

_published_faq.name: How do I add DOST to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add DOST to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.dost.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the DOST MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: DOST provides these MCP tools: assign_workflow, create_input_mapping, create_workflow, get_document_details, get_document_in_format, get_documents, get_input_mappings, get_workflows, and reassign_workflow_approver.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to DOST?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to DOST in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
DOST requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
DOST is developed by Dost. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
